title: Optimized Weight Initialization on the Stiefel Manifold for Deep ReLU Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2509.00362v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Stable and efficient training of ReLU networks with large depth is highly sensitive to weight initialization. Improper initialization can cause permanent neuron inactivation dying ReLU and exacerbate gradient instability as network depth increases. Methods such as He, Xavier, and orthogonal initialization preserve variance or promote approximate isometry. However, they do not necessarily regulate the pre-activation mean or control activation sparsity, and their effectiveness often diminishes in very deep architectures. This work introduces a semi-orthogonal initialization specifically optimized for ReLU by solving an optimization problem on the Stiefel manifold, thereby preserving scale and calibrating the pre-activation statistics from the outset. translated_title: 深度ReLU神经网络中基于Stiefel流形的最优权重初始化方法
translated_abstract: 对于深度较大的ReLU网络而言，稳定且高效的训练对权重初始化高度敏感。不当的初始化会导致神经元永久性失活（即“死亡ReLU”问题），并随着网络深度的增加而加剧梯度不稳定性。He初始化、Xavier初始化和正交初始化等方法能够保持方差或实现近似等距性，但它们并不一定能调节预激活均值或控制激活稀疏性，而且在极深的网络架构中，这些方法的有效性往往会减弱。本工作通过在Stiefel流形上求解一个优化问题，提出了一种专门针对ReLU优化的半正交初始化方法，从而从一开始就保持尺度并对预激活统计特性进行校准。文中推导出了一族闭式解以及一种高效的采样方案。在初始化时刻的理论分析表明，所提出的初始化方法能够缓解死亡ReLU问题，减缓……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过在Stiefel流形上求解优化问题，提出了一种专为ReLU网络设计的半正交权重初始化方法，能够从初始化时刻起校准预激活统计特性、缓解死亡ReLU问题并稳定极深网络的训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semi-orthogonal weight initialization scheme specifically optimized for ReLU networks by solving an optimization problem on the Stiefel manifold, which calibrates pre-activation statistics from the outset, mitigates the dying ReLU problem, and stabilizes training of very deep networks.
